headline: Criteria met: 94 of 101. Chapter cards complete: 8 of 13 (M4, C1, C2, C3, S1, S3, T1, T3). Stormwood landed card S1 (integrated re-run at 0068c542, strict re-check MET) and F10#2 (C3 on the current fight camera, all six named fights PASS). Since 14:15: Meadows landed F03#0 and F04#3 (#417, #419) and F01#2/#3 (the day and night walks); Balance landed F10#2 starter parity and the F04#7 C2 half (#413); Cloudreach landed owned-carrier Fly (#411) and finished. Open: Meadows 4 (F04#1, F04#2, F04#6, F04#7 C3), Stormwood 1 (F10#6), Tidewake 2 (F14#0, F14#1); cards M1–M3, S2, T2.
Main is green: CI passed on every merge through #417, and the runs for #418 and #419 are going. The auto-merge workflow dispatches CI after each merge.

F04#7 (owner option c): harder five-member captains at the level ceiling. Bar: reader win ≥ 0.75; masher lead-faint = 1.00; reader median party cost ≤ 0.55× the masher's; a masher loses at least one Meadows named fight in ≥ 25% of seeded playthroughs. Per fight, Vance and Vess never beat a masher (disclosed). The Balance lane is running tests before it lands. The same bar applies to Tidewake F14#0.
The owner has delegated lane decisions to the coordinator. Lanes land their own PRs and update this board and STATE.
